newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba says will not hold press conference.
newsitem.headline: Buba says will not hold press conference.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday that it would not hold a press conference after its regular council meeting.
All 10 economists polled by Reuters said they expected the central bank to keep all its interest rates on hold at the meeting.
But three of the 10 said they expected the Bundesbank to free securities repurchase agreements, or repos, from minimum reserve requirements.
